# Copilot Instructions for Astro Website

This is an Astro website project built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Project Setup
- Framework: Astro 4.0+
- Language: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Package Manager: npm

## Key Files
- `src/pages/` - Astro pages (automatically routed)
- `src/layouts/` - Layout templates
- `src/components/` - Reusable components
- `src/styles/` - Global and component styles
- `astro.config.mjs` - Astro configuration

## Development Commands
- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run preview` - Preview production build

## Guidelines
- Add new pages to `src/pages/`
- Create reusable components in `src/components/`
- Use the `Layout.astro` component as a base for pages
- Add global styles to `src/styles/global.css`
- Component-specific styles can be scoped within `<style>` tags
